description: Grouped weekly updates, so dependency PRs arrive as one reviewable batch instead of a drip. Majors stay individual — a major is a decision, not a batch item.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all non-major bumps, except the packages called out below.
Electron updates ship a new runtime to every user's machine — each one gets its own PR and a human decision, whatever the semver level says.

electron-store stays on 8.x deliberately. The old CJS constraint is gone (the main process is ESM now and imports it; it is externalized from the bundle via ELECTRON_NATIVE in apps/desktop/vite.config.ts), but the workspace and session registries persist through it on disk, so a major is a hand-checked data-migration decision, not an automated bump.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes do not wait for Monday.
